name: At-Home Saliva Cancer Screener
raw_text: A direct-to-consumer kit that analyzes saliva biomarkers at home to detect early-stage cancers with 99% claimed accuracy, sold as a $29 monthly subscription.

name: On-Demand Jet Ski Delivery & Rental App
